original_test_intent: Visually verify the identified PSU LED behavior during the owner-defined PWM-high state.

original_procedure_criteria.procedure: Create the approved PWM-high state and directly observe the mapped LED.
original_procedure_criteria.criteria: LED matches the platform-defined high-state behavior.

historical_reviews.v3: RECLASSIFIED to MANUAL ONLY; missing state method is readiness, not semantic block.

v3_1_conclusion.manual_test_activity: Engineer observes the LED; agent may assist only with an approved state command and evidence timing.

master_vs_project_parameters.project_inputs: Exact PSU/LED map, high-state generation, expected color/pattern/timing.
master_vs_project_parameters.coverage_difference: Telemetry cannot replace the visual response.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Synchronize operator video with the approved control/evidence timeline.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Do not infer electrical PWM drive from the label.

no_automatic_retry: No repeated stimulus after abnormal behavior without approval.
review_improvement: KEEP: V3 already matches the WebUI/visual principle and treats inputs separately from capability.
